mapper.sql: id, document_id, block_index, parent_block_id, type, section_path, customer_clause_no, content, source_anchor, provenance, processing_status
mapper.select: select from document_block where document_id = #{documentId} order by block_index asc
mapper.insert: insert into document_block (id, document_id, block_index, parent_block_id, type, section_path, customer_clause_no, content, source_anchor, provenance, processing_status) values (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{blockIndex}, #{parentBlockId}, #{type}, #{sectionPath}, #{customerClauseNo}, #{content}, #{sourceAnchor}, #{provenance}, #{processingStatus})
